# Support

## Ask a question or report a problem

Use the [GitHub issue templates](https://github.com/Zakkaus/doona/issues/new/choose) for doona problems and feature requests. Search existing issues before opening a report.

For backend configuration, routing, DNS, or proxy behavior, ask in the [honk project](https://github.com/daeuniverse/honk). State whether the problem also occurs without doona.

## Include diagnostic information

- doona version or commit.
- Backend name and version, or `mock` if using the demo.
- Browser name and version, and operating system.
- Deployment path, such as `/` or `/ui/`, and relevant reverse-proxy configuration.
- Reproduction steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
- Relevant console errors, failed requests, and screenshots.

Remove bearer tokens, credentials, and private data before posting logs, configuration, or screenshots. Report suspected vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), not in a public issue.
